links.evidence: In the private sector we face intense competition from H&R Block, which provides assisted tax preparation services in its stores and a competing software offering called H&R Block At Home.
The principal customers of our heavy-duty truck engines include truck manufacturers such as ... Navistar International Corporation (Navistar)
As of December 31, 2020, a customer of our Semiconductor Test segment, JA Mitsui Leasing, Ltd., accounted for 25% of our accounts receivable balance.
The Company sold a majority interest in our previously consolidated bottling operations in the Philippines ("Philippine bottling operations") to Coca-Cola FEMSA in January 2013
The Company's equity method investments include, but are not limited to, our ownership interests in Coca-Cola European Partners plc ("CCEP")
In the United Kingdom, we partner in a cost-sharing arrangement with another supplier, Bacardi Limited, to sell a portfolio of both companies’ brands.
On July 5, 2018, we and Embraer S.A. (Embraer) announced the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding to establish a strategic partnership between the two companies.
Our competitors include but are not limited to: • Maxim Integrated Products, Inc.
For 2011, Corning’s sales to Sharp Electronics Corporation, a customer of our Display Technologies segment, represented 10% of the Company’s consolidated net sales.
Direct sales to WT Microelectronics Co., Ltd., a distributor, accounted for 21% and 20% of our net revenue for fiscal years 2023 and 2022, respectively.
In 2012, Hewlett-Packard Company accounted for 18% of our net revenue (19% in 2011 and 21% in 2010)
